nodes.label: finance CLI (Enable Banking open banking)
nodes.rationale: Auth is a fresh RS256 self-signed JWT per API request, so no OAuth token storage or refresh; consent lasts 90 days via valid_until. Restricted mode links own accounts with no commercial contract.

nodes.label: Enable Banking UK Coverage Limitation
nodes.rationale: The block is about WHERE the user consents from, not a permanent per-bank ban: the same Revolut Bank UAB (LT) link that failed for a UK-based PSU in May 2026 succeeded in July 2026 for the same user consenting from the EU. A 'confirmed' failure can be circumstantial rather than structural, so retry when circumstances change.

nodes.label: Config Keys Are Not Evidence Rule
nodes.rationale: config.json accumulates vestigial keys (environment: sandbox, stray tokens) the CLI never reads; it authenticates with exactly app_id, key_path, and session_id. Calling REAL financial data 'fake sandbox data' is as damaging as trusting fake data; the decisive liveness test is a fresh user-consented session returning the same values.

nodes.label: Finance Transaction Watcher Daemon
nodes.rationale: Polls Enable Banking every 5 minutes and writes new-transaction notifications; on first start with no seen file it seeds the last 30 days so old transactions never trigger notifications.
